{{Quote|Why you slimy excuse for a Nimbanese jowl-preener…|[[Diergu-Rea Duhnes'rd]], about [[Sevik (criminal)|Sevik]]|<ref name="Journal13">{{JournalCite|13|Day of the Sepulchral Night (short story)}}</ref>}}
'''Nimban''' was a [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Having evolved from [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Nimbanel precursor species|reptiles]] that had tracked moving [[Plant/Legends|plants]] across Nimban's plains, the Nimbanese preferred an intellectual approach to problem-solving instead of violence and excelled at dealing with [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracies]]. Nimban was a part of the [[Hutt Empire]] by [[25,102 BBY]], and the Nimbanese played an important role in the foundation of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] around [[18,000 BBY]].

Nimban eventually became a member world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], however, the Nimbanese [[Krovalis clan]] led the species and their homeworld into seceding from the Republic and petitioning the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt clans]] to voluntarily become a part of Hutt Space and enter servitude to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, Nimban was the site of the headquarters of the companies [[Delban Faxicorp]] and [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] eventually [[Battle of the Nimban system|conquered]] the [[Nimban system/Legends|Nimban system]] as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Description==
Nimban was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Nimbanel">{{CSWECite|II|382|Nimbanel (Plural: Nimbanese)}}</ref> located in the [[Nimban system/Legends|Nimban system]], a part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']], which linked it to the [[Nar Kreeta system/Legends|Nar Kreeta]] and [[Sleheyron system/Legends|Sleheyron systems]] and also served as the endpoint of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]<ref name="Sisar" /> [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route, which connected it to the [[Sionia system/Legends|Sionia system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The length of Nimban's [[local year]] was three fifths of a [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]], and the planet's surface featured nine continents.<ref name="GG12" />

A very gentle and peaceful world,<ref name="GG12" /> Nimban had a peculiar ecology<ref name="LoNH" /> wherein a [[Nimbanel precursor species|species]] of grazing [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] that was at one point at the top of the Nimbanese [[Diet/Legends|food]] chain tracked<ref name="GG12" /> unusual<ref name="LoNH" /> [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that were traveling across the planet's plains. Those plants evolved progressively more sophisticated means of protecting their [[Seed/Legends|seeds]], while the reptiles—which eventually evolved into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG12" />—adapted in order to extract the plants' [[Foodstuff/Legends|edible]] portions.<ref name="LoNH" /> Thus, the Nimbanese began to craft tools to reach the [[boyy'lo]] plant's [[Berry/Legends|berries]] and developed analytical skills in order to unlock<ref name="GG12" /> the interlocking [[Flower/Legends|petals]] of the [[puzzleflower]].<ref name="CSWE puzzleflower" /> Nimban was also home to the creature known as the [[Nimbanese jowl-preener|jowlpreener]].<ref name="CSWE jowlpreener" />

==History==
===Early history===
[[File:NimbanHuttEmpire-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Nimban was a part of the Hutt Empire by 25,102 BBY.]]
At some point, the Nimbanese of Nimban developed primitive [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel technology and [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] several planets in their [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="GG12" /> By [[25,102 BBY]], Nimban was a part of the [[Hutt Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] of<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> the planet's native<ref name="GG12" /> Nimbanel species served masters of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species offworld during that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

After the Nimbanese were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="GG12" /> they became instrumental in founding the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]],<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> a supragovernmental [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] regulation agency, around [[18,000 BBY]]. Although the Republic [[Scout/Legends|explored]] space surrounding Nimban between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the planet was situated outside of both the Republic's and Hutt Space's borders between around 15,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and approximately [[11,000 BBY]]. In [[11,939 BBY]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]] of the Republic, which was controlled by the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] sect at the time, advanced toward Nimban as part of the [[Third Pius Dea Crusade]] that was waged against the Hutt species.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' — Based on corresponding data for [[Nimban system/Legends|Nimban system]]</ref>

===Joining and leaving the Republic===
[[File:HuttSpace22BBY-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|300px|By 22 BBY, Nimban had joined Hutt Space.]]
Nimban eventually became a member world of the Republic with representatives in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. However, by several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="LoNH" /> the Nimbanese had observed the encroachment of Hutt Space upon their territory. The Nimbanese [[Krovalis clan]] had applied to become a data holder family of the Bureau of Ships and Services and approached the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt clans]], offering its species' servitude as well as complete access to the Nimbanese [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] and holdings. In return, the Hutts would back the Krovalis bid with the Bureau of Ships and Services and would also ensure the Nimbanese their continued relative freedom and standard of living.<ref name="GG12" />

Thus, Nimban seceded from the Republic and successfully petitioned to become a part of Hutt Space<ref name="LoNH" /> at some point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> a decision that brought the world [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] renown.<ref name="LoNH" /> Nevertheless, during the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that year, the Republic's [[Thirteenth Army|Thirteenth Sector Army]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Nimban's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" />

At some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Nimban system|conquered]] the Nimban system as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy. The Yuuzhan Vong also [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]]<ref name="TEA" /> the Sisar Run's<ref name="Sisar" /> industrial world [[Dirha]], which up to that point had served as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point for starships traveling to Nimban. The Nimban system remained under the invaders' control by 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Nimbanel/Legends}}
[[File:TawssKhaaAsMosepBinneed-ANewHopeLimited.jpg|thumb|right|295px|Nimban was the homeworld of the Nimbanese, including the fortune teller Tawss Khaa.]]
Nimban was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Nimbanese, a species of sentient, [[Endothermy|endothermic]] reptilian [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].<ref name="GG12" /> All Nimbanese spoke the [[Nimbanese (language)|Nimbanese]] [[Language/Legends|language]] as well as the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] language of the Hutt species and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], the lingua franca of the wider galaxy.<ref name="UAA" /> The population of the Nimban system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one and ten billion.<ref name="TEA" />

The Nimbanese were renowned for their labyrinthine [[Brain/Legends|mind-set]] and their ability to navigate extensive records and information systems easily,<ref name="LoNH" /> and they were naturally inclined toward maintaining various [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracies]].<ref name="GG12" /> The Nimbanese favored an intellectual approach to solving problems, and it even replaced intraspecies warfare for them.<ref name="LoNH" /> The Nimbanese society was organized into clan states that eventually spread across all of Nimban's continents, and since early in the species' history, clan rivalries were resolved through puzzle competitions known as [[muhndee]]s. The muhndees eventually evolved into an annually held event, with rivalries between the clans morphing into relatively benign competition. In addition, heads of Nimbanese families competed for membership in the councils of their clans in electoral muhndees held every five local years.<ref name="GG12" />

The Nimbanese had access to standard galactic technology, such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], as well as advanced data storage and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems that were valued in the wider galaxy. The [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]]<ref name="GG12" /> and [[Fortune teller/Legends|fortune teller]] [[Tawss Khaa/Legends|Tawss Khaa]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Tawss Khaa}}</ref> were both Nimbanels who hailed from Nimban.<ref name="Insider130">{{InsiderCite|130|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley}}</ref>

==Locations==
Nimban was the site of an office of the Bureau of Ships and Services,<ref name="GG12" /> and by the time of the Galactic Civil War, it had also come to host the headquarters of the droid manufacturing company [[Delban Faxicorp]] and the starship manufacturer [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]]<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I gathered the roster of worlds that hadn't been placed but that sources indicated were in Hutt Space—the likes of Saki, Ganath, Kleeva, Moralan, Circumtore, and Nimban—and added them to the map in pencil.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS – Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
[[File:GalaxyGuide12.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Nimban was introduced in ''Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies''.]]
Nimban was created by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG12" /> Although the [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''<ref name="UAA" /> and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' of [[2008]] both placed Nimban in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="CSWE Nimbanel" /> the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] instead placed it in grid square S-10 as part of Hutt Space.<ref name="TEA" />

In a 2009 [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu]] article describing the creation of the map of Hutt Space for ''The Essential Atlas'', Fry related that in [[2006]], after sketching an outline for the borders of that region with a ballpoint pen and noting the few systems that previously published sources had placed on maps, he composed a list of worlds that were implied to be in Hutt Space but had not been explicitly depicted as part of the region. During that process, Fry added Nimban to the map-in-progress in pencil.<ref name="Suvudu" />
